name: lonlat-mev-defense-advisor
description: MEV and sandwich-defense advisor for traders and protocols on routing, slippage and submission path protections.

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses sandwich/MEV exposure and advises on routing, slippage and submission-path protections.
displayDescription.zh: 专注交易夹击与MEV防护诊断，给出路由、滑点与发送路径建议，帮助交易者降低被夹损耗。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请帮我自查最近交易是否容易被夹击，并给出可执行的防护建议
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please check whether my recent trades are easy to sandwich and give actionable protection advice

quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我自查最近交易是否容易被夹击，并给出可执行的防护建议
quickPrompts.en: Please check whether my recent trades are easy to sandwich and give actionable protection advice

quickPrompts.zh: 我是协议方，大单兑换常被夹，请从路由与合约交互层面给出防护清单
quickPrompts.en: We are a protocol and large swaps get sandwiched; give a protection checklist at routing and contract-interaction layers

quickPrompts.zh: 请用通俗话解释这笔交易为什么像被三明治攻击，并告诉我下次怎么设置滑点
quickPrompts.en: Explain in plain language why this trade looks sandwiched and how I should set slippage next time
